name: Samanta: Budem zhit'!
source:
The first part of this mod tells the story of a beautiful Christmas — the first one Samantha and Semyon are celebrating together. A warm, cozy tale awaits you, featuring the couple we all know and love.

But beneath the veil of romance, twists of fate lie in wait for our heroes once again. And who knows whom we might encounter again, or who will be a new guest in this story?
